entries.source: SDK 26.2 headers for the declaration and its availability, which give 17.0; the value read out of the host's own Foundation by dlsym in tests/backports/host/foundation-constants/, which compares every value it carries against the host's and mutates each one to show the comparison notices that constant. The band is the ladder's answer and not the annotation's: tools/release-split.lua over the held caches puts the first release that exports _NSFileProtectionCompleteWhenUserInactive at 18.0, and 18.0 is that first rung rather than the release it arrived in - 18.0 is the newest rung the ladder holds and nothing is held between 12.0 and 16.0, so 18.0 is an upper bound and the release in it is 17.0 by the annotation, which is the sibling NSURLFileProtectionCompleteWhenUserInactive's own maximum in the same tree

entries.effect: the identifier's language part with the POSIX underscore written as the BCP-47 hyphen and every extension dropped: en_US@rg=gbzzzz answers en-US, en_US answers en-US and en answers en; a locale whose identifier names no language answers nil
entries.source: the SDK 26.2 NSLocale.h declaration and its comment, which state both the availability and the en_US@rg=gbzzzz -> en-US example, and the 6.0 armv7 cache read class-scoped with python3 over ~/.charon/dyld/6.0/classes_armv7.json: NSLocale carries -localeIdentifier and -objectForKey: and no class in the 11284 read in that run carries languageIdentifier, so the value is computed from what the release does have. The ladder and its control are in facts/Foundation/NSLocaleIdentifiers.md

entries.effect: the rg subtag wins and its region is uppercased, so en_US@rg=gbzzzz answers GB; without an rg subtag the answer is the locale's country code, and a locale that names no region answers nil
entries.source: the SDK 26.2 NSLocale.h declaration and its comment, which state the rg-precedence, the GB example and the nil case, and the 6.0 armv7 cache read class-scoped with python3 over ~/.charon/dyld/6.0/classes_armv7.json: the regionCode selector string is in the 6.0 and 4.3 selector dumps but the only class owning it in either release is the private -[AADeviceInfo regionCode], while NSLocale carries -localeIdentifier and -objectForKey: with NSLocaleCountryCode, so the value is computed here rather than asked of the dictionary; the rg extension is a BCP-47 subtag CoreFoundation on 6.0 does not know. The ladder and its control are in facts/Foundation/NSLocaleIdentifiers.md
